name: Human Digestive System (Gastrointestinal Tract & Accessory Organs)
semanticDescription: Anatomically authentic 3D model of the human digestive system including mouth, pharynx, continuous esophagus, J-shaped muscular stomach, liver with right/left lobes, gallbladder with cystic duct, pancreas with main pancreatic duct converging at the hepatopancreatic ampulla (Ampulla of Vater) entering the duodenal C-loop, continuous coiled small intestine (jejunum and ileum), and large intestine (caecum with vermiform appendix, haustrated colon, rectum, and anal canal). Aligned with CBSE Class 10 Biology Ch 5 Figure 5.6 and CBSE Class 11 Biology Ch 16 Figures 16.1-16.3.
simplifications: Intestinal coils modeled as continuous serpentine loops for pedagogical clarity while maintaining complete lumen continuity.
Colon haustrations rendered as distinct anatomical sacculations along the continuous colic pathway.

materials.look: Soft pinkish muscular swallowing tube with tissue subsurface scattering
Coral muscular digestive reservoir with J-shaped curvatures
Reddish-brown hepatic metabolic gland with right and left lobes
Emerald green bile storage sac with cystic duct
Golden-amber exocrine/endocrine gland with pancreatic duct
Continuous warm pink nutrient absorption loops (duodenum, jejunum, ileum)
Segmented water absorption colon with caecum, appendix, and haustra
